result:
I would dissolve the barrier between minds.

I would make it biologically and perceptually impossible to hold another human being's experience at a distance. If you struck someone, you would feel the sting immediately. If you lied, you would taste the dissonance in your own mouth. If you caused suffering, you would experience the grief of the victim as a shadow of your own.

Not through magic, but through a fundamental rewrite of consciousness: removing the silence and distance that allow one person to dehumanize another. In a world where empathy is not a choice but a constant, inescapable reality, the cost of harm outweighs any conceivable gain of action.

The root of most conflict is not malice; it is ignorance. It is the ability to look into another's eyes and not truly see them. Remove that capability, and the war ends by default. That is the only change I would want.
